Meet the team

The people behind the robot.

Our team is made up of five dedicated students who bring together design, programming, strategy, and leadership to build something incredible each season.

About the team

We are 20181 Lancer robotics from Shawnee Mission East. Our junior/senior team has around 3 years of experience with FTC and we are all extremely invested in the program. Here at East, we value diversified perspectives and seek team members with experience in all different kinds of other activities. Our team members participate in things such as rock climbing, woodworking, martial arts, fencing, SME Environmental Club, the SME Physics Club, Scouting America, Band, and several other extracurricular activities. We pride ourselves in our capabilities to create specialized components supporting creative and innovative designs in robotics.

Organization and management

Community

A critical component of our team's success is building a strong sense of community. For this purpose, we try to make sure everyone feels involved and that everyone is contributing.

Meeting Structure

We meet three times a week on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday after school from 3:00 to 4:30, as well as on occasional weekends and Fridays before competitions. At the beginning of each meeting, we set small goals and split them up between group members.

Leadership

Our two captains assign builders certain functions of our bot, and then they specialize on that hardware for that portion. This gives every team member a chance to experience a leadership role.

Embracing Mistakes

We can always learn from our mistakes. We foster a culture where it is important to take responsibility for our mistakes so everyone can learn. This prevents mistakes from being repeated.

Competition Procedures

One or two members are assigned to be scouts. This means collecting data about other teams and their robots at competitions. We use this information to create strategies before matches.
